headline: Structured Authority Injection Paves Way for Persistent Human Control in AI Agents
summary: A new research paper proposes Structured Authority Injection, a method enabling persistent human control over large language model (LLM) agents. This approach could significantly enhance the safety and ethical oversight of AI systems in various applications.
whyItMatters: It addresses the critical need for human oversight in AI systems, potentially mitigating risks and ensuring more responsible AI deployment.

primaryArticle.title: Structured Authority Injection: Persistent Human Control for LLM Agents via Typed MCP Overrides
